intro: Every wedding, session, and story is different — pricing is tailored to match. Reach out with a few details and I'll send a full guide within 48 hours.

tiers.label: Tier 01
tiers.name: The Intimate
tiers.description: Small weddings, elopements, and courthouse-to-dinner days. Perfect for couples focused on the ceremony and the people closest to them.

tiers.label: Tier 02 · Most Popular
tiers.name: The Signature
tiers.description: Full wedding-day storytelling from getting ready to the last dance. The tier most couples land on.

tiers.label: Tier 03
tiers.name: The Full Story
tiers.description: For celebrations with multiple events, travel, or a large guest count. Second-shooter coverage and extended hours built in.

addons.name: Additional coverage hour
addons.description: Extra time for late-night dance floors or long getting-ready mornings.

addons.name: Second photographer
addons.description: A second set of eyes for two-location days and larger celebrations.

addons.name: Engagement session
addons.description: A relaxed golden-hour session — great for save-the-dates and getting comfortable in front of the camera.

addons.name: Rehearsal-dinner coverage
addons.description: Two hours of documentary coverage the night before the wedding.

addons.name: Fine-art album
addons.description: Linen or leather-bound heirloom albums, designed by hand.

addons.name: Destination travel
addons.description: Travel outside Buffalo and Germany. Quoted per trip based on distance and length.
